function add(a: number, b: number) {
  console.log(a + b);
}
function maybe(flag: boolean): void | number {
  if (flag) return 1;
}
class Counter {
  value = 0;
  increment() {
    this.value++;
  }
}
let total = 1;
const sum = add(1, 2) + 1;
const difference = 10 - add(1, 2);
const power = add(1, 2) ** 2;
const bits = add(1, 2) | 0;
const less = add(1, 2) < 3;
const atLeast = 3 >= add(1, 2);
total += add(1, 2);
total -= add(1, 2);
const doubled = new Counter().increment() * 2;
const lengths = [1, 2].forEach((x) => x) + 1;
const partial = maybe(true) + 1;
const compared = maybe(true) < 2;
const voids = add(1, 2) > add(3, 4);
const text = "result: " + add(1, 2);
const negated = -add(1, 2);
console.log(sum, difference, power, bits, less, atLeast, total, doubled, lengths, partial, compared, voids, text, negated);
